method.description: One-off local adapter manually invokes the current app's existing section playback plan and voices through OfflineAudioContext with deterministic Math.random and a virtual currentTime shim; 40 ms leader omitted, exact score-duration body copied, 3 s FX tail stored separately.
limitations: The app does not expose a supported offline rendering API; these scripts are an investigation adapter, not normal project tooling.

Nonfinite/clipping counters originate from the pre-PCM OfflineAudioContext buffer; PCM payload verification independently recomputes decoded WAV metrics but cannot recover NaNs sanitized by conversion or samples outside the crops.
The corrected receipt's complete JSON is gzip-compressed losslessly; original byte length and SHA-256 are recorded by the archive verification receipt.
No listening or owner acceptance is represented; these WAVs are not admitted as final game audio, runtime/package content, or seamless loops.
The per-cue 0.421 Hz chorus LFO is not phase-aligned to the 3, 6, or 12 second body lengths; tails and boundary differences remain.
The original bad-hash receipt discrepancy is retained in provenance-red.json; no WAVs from that run are included.
